task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Write a full QPE program in Qiskit (3 ancilla qubits, target unitary P(2*pi*0.75)) including the inverse QFT, and report the most likely phase estimate. Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
